hypothesis: For the immutable retained v39 trace, the explicit heuristic 'later aggregate keys_held event with the same key' does not uniquely associate every per-key input_admission row with a hold row.
test: Hash-check events.jsonl, parse raw event rows, and for each input_admission count and list all later keys_held rows whose keys contain the admitted key. Independent auditor recomputes from raw input using a separate algorithm and checks counts and output rows.
decision: PASS_HEURISTIC_NONUNIQUENESS_SCOPED if source hash matches, input counts are 39 admissions/28 aggregate holds, at least one admission has >1 candidate, and independent audit reproduces every per-row count with zero errors. FAIL if all admissions have exactly one candidate; HOLD for source or audit mismatch.
competing_explanation: An undocumented strict serial-order invariant plus other runtime artifacts might permit a different reconstruction; this test assesses only the frozen timestamp-and-key-membership heuristic.
uncertainty: One historical trace; heuristic candidates are not proof of true ownership. No per-key physical up/release, actual input state, causal effect, semantic utility, recovery, live threat response, or MAP01 outcome is measured.
